name: ac195_thiruparankundram_ward_boundaries
notes: Empty until per-ward boundaries are mapped. Per-feature properties.wardId must match a row in the wards table. Use lib/db/scripts/fetch-ward-boundaries.mjs to refresh from OSM, then hand-edit each feature's wardId. Wards without a matching feature fall back to a labelled centroid pin on the public map; partial coverage is supported.
